entities.name: Solothurn–Langnau railway
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Solothurn–Langnau railway is a railway line in the Emmental in Switzerland. It was built by the Emmentalbahn, which was based in Burgdorf. The line runs from Solothurn via Burgdorf to Langnau im Emmental. It is now part of BLS AG. Solothurn–Langnau railway is a railway line from Europe. Classified as Tier D (Quantitative) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
